name: unkai-mobile
description: Unkai Mail for iOS and Android — the Tauri mobile shell around the Rust core.

scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:clean && tauri ios build
scripts.ios:sim: npm run ios:clean && tauri ios build --debug --target aarch64-sim
scripts._comment_ios_clean: tauri ios build exports through gen/apple/build and fails with 'Directory not empty' when any previous output is still there — clearing the archive alone is not enough, the per-arch dir collides too. The whole build dir is generated, so dropping it costs only the re-link.
